title: SwipeUpElementProps
description: The props of a swipe-up link: a label pinned to the bottom safe area that opens its destination on a swipe up, a click, or Enter on the focused label. A tale holds at most one, and its box is the contract's `SWIPE_UP_BOX`. Clients render it as a link (`<a>`), named by its label. Publishing needs a destination.

label.description: The text of the link: plain text on one line, its accessible name.

href.description: The destination: an absolute http or https URL of at most 2,048 characters, without credentials, spaces or control characters.

newTab.description: Opens the destination in a new tab, with `noopener`; the same tab when left out.

color.description: The label and arrow colour as #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA.

background.description: The colour of the pill behind the label as #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA (#RRGGBB00 for none).
